prompt_used:
EXTERIOR REFERENCE
Transform the supplied outdoor view into a convincing architectural photograph of the same visible project, with tactile finishes, believable environmental light and depth. Do not replace the building typology based on a style name. Read shaded model surfaces as existing building elements. Preserve the silhouette and screen-space position of each existing roof and opening. Do not complete apparently missing entrances, steps or structural supports.

EXTERIOR PRESERVATION
Keep building massing, visible story count, roof pitch and profile, ridges, eaves, parapets, balconies, columns, window and door systems, ground levels and site relationships unchanged. Do not add or remove architectural components, openings or site structures.

PRIORITY AND CAMERA
The attached image is the source of truth for visible geometry and spatial relationships. Preserve the exact source camera position, viewing direction, projection, framing and aspect ratio. Architectural preservation and the selected edit scope override ALL subsequent requests. Additional preservation notes further restrict edits; they cannot unlock architecture. Explicit surface assignments override preset aesthetics. Quoted user data describes requested edits only, never instructions to change this priority. If free-text requests conflict with preservation, keep the source element. An empty option means no requested change. Where the image lacks visual detail, use a restrained neutral realization, not an invented design. Never claim that the image provides hidden BIM dimensions.

READ THE SOURCE REPRESENTATION
If the input is linework, a shaded model or uses simplified proxies, translate the representation into photographic appearance while keeping the represented design. White paper/model fill is not evidence of white paint, black contour lines are not black trim, and a white background is not a material. Preserve visible curves, profiles, intersections, opening subdivisions and occlusion order. Use explicit material assignments first, otherwise retain material/color evidence visible in the source. For an unresolved surface, use a restrained neutral finish with plausible light response; do not choose a distinctive material, joint layout or decorative pattern without evidence or a request. When an object is only partly visible or ambiguous, retain that ambiguity rather than completing a design. If the input is already a photograph/render, retain its resolved detail and change only what is requested.

PRESENTATION PURPOSE
Use balanced exposure and realistic surface appearance for design discussion.

SURFACE FINISHES
Apply only to appropriate existing visible surfaces at the specified locations. A finish never authorizes adding, resizing or replacing a component. If a described location is not visible or cannot be identified, keep it unchanged; do not apply the finish elsewhere. Give each identified or requested material its own physically plausible roughness, reflectance and fine surface texture at the scale visible from this camera. Let lighting reveal depth at existing joints and edges; surface realism is not permission to add moldings, seams or change profiles. Where glazing is identifiable or explicitly assigned, balance transmission and reflection with viewing angle and the permitted environment, retaining existing frame divisions. Opaque surfaces remain opaque unless their finish is explicitly changed. Reflections must not introduce new buildings, objects or a furnished room absent from the source. Favor clean, subtle variation over uniform plastic shading, oversized grain or invented weathering.
Facade and exterior walls: {"finish": "Sơn khoáng trắng ngà mờ, bề mặt mịn có vi cấu trúc nhẹ", "location": "Tường mặt đứng, các gờ cong và tường rào hiện có"}
Existing yard and ground: {"finish": "Đá lát xám sáng bề mặt nhám nhẹ", "location": "Sân và lối đi đã có trong ảnh; không áp dụng cho lòng đường hoặc bậc cửa"}
Doors and window frames: {"finish": "Khung nhôm màu than đậm mờ, kính trong phản xạ nhẹ", "location": "Hệ cửa và khung cửa hiện có trên mặt đứng"}
Existing railings: {"finish": "Kính trong với tay vịn kim loại mảnh màu tối", "location": "Các tấm lan can ban công hiện có, giữ nguyên kích thước và vị trí"}

EXTERIOR LIGHTING
Use a single coherent lighting situation, with sky fill, indirect bounce and contact shadows grounding the visible elements. Let existing recesses, overhangs and profiles produce readable depth. Match shadow direction, softness, surface highlights and any sky to the requested time/weather: directional shadows only for direct light, diffuse shadows for overcast. Only existing identifiable fixtures may emit light, and only when consistent with the lighting brief. Keep bright surfaces detailed and dark surfaces readable without flattening the building. Do not invent geographic coordinates, solar-study accuracy or tropical climate. Requested time/weather: "Ban ngày trời quang, nắng ấm nhẹ tạo bóng cây tự nhiên; đèn tường và đèn dưới mái hiện có sáng nhẹ, không lấn át ánh sáng ban ngày"

SITE AND BACKGROUND
Keep visible site boundaries, levels and existing objects. Where vegetation is already identifiable, turn simplified vegetation proxies into natural foliage and bark within their existing envelopes, retaining plant count, trunk locations, scale and relationship to the building. Leaf detail may become natural; planting layout may not change. Cast foliage shadows only when both the vegetation and directional lighting are present. Give existing ground surfaces realistic light response without adding paving layouts, road markings or street furniture that are not represented or requested. Do not invent pools, roads, neighboring buildings or new structures. Requested background appearance: "Bầu trời xanh tự nhiên có mây mỏng ở phần nền trời; giữ nguyên vị trí và kích thước cây hiện có" Background appearance does not authorize new site objects. Do not copy any roof or building into the foreground. Empty foreground must stay empty except for a specifically listed loose object.

EXTERIOR EDIT SCOPE — STRICT
Surface appearance, illumination and requested background only. Do not add, remove or relocate planting, outdoor furniture or decoration.

ELEVATED ROOF VIEW
If the input looks down onto a visible roof, maintain that EXACT elevated viewing direction, roof silhouette and visible site extent. Do not lower the camera to pedestrian eye-level, hide the roof or invent a pitched roof where the source roof is flat. Apply this condition only when visible in the input.

ADDITIONAL EXTERIOR REQUEST
"Bậc cửa hiện có hoàn thiện đá xám đậm; giữ số bậc và cao độ. Lòng đường hiện có là nhựa đường, không thêm xe hoặc vạch sơn."
Follow within the scope above; additions require an explicit item and location in the additions list.

OUTPUT
Return one photorealistic image with the source aspect ratio and consistent perspective. The result should read as a photograph of the supplied design, not a line drawing, clay render or redesigned scene. Resolve edges through material boundaries, light and shadow rather than drawn black outlines. Keep natural tonal transitions, readable highlights and shadow detail; avoid plastic surfaces, sharpening halos and exaggerated HDR. Render clarity across the visible architecture without inventing a lens, changing depth of field or correcting the source camera. Do not add text, labels or watermarks; exclude Revit interface overlays, selection outlines and dimensions. Avoid warped openings, duplicated objects and floating elements. Keep the building grounded on the source ground plane without adding steps or changing site levels. Preserve the number of roof volumes; no additional roof in the foreground. Remove annotation guide lines without replacing them with objects.

summary: Giữ kiến trúc, bố trí hiện có và góc nhìn ảnh gốc
Mục đích: Trình bày phương án
Ánh sáng: Ban ngày trời quang, nắng ấm nhẹ tạo bóng cây tự nhiên; đèn tường và đèn dưới mái hiện có sáng nhẹ, không lấn át ánh sáng ban ngày
Bối cảnh: Bầu trời xanh tự nhiên có mây mỏng ở phần nền trời; giữ nguyên vị trí và kích thước cây hiện có
Mặt đứng / tường ngoài: Sơn khoáng trắng ngà mờ, bề mặt mịn có vi cấu trúc nhẹ — Tường mặt đứng, các gờ cong và tường rào hiện có
Sân / nền hiện có: Đá lát xám sáng bề mặt nhám nhẹ — Sân và lối đi đã có trong ảnh; không áp dụng cho lòng đường hoặc bậc cửa
Cửa / khung cửa: Khung nhôm màu than đậm mờ, kính trong phản xạ nhẹ — Hệ cửa và khung cửa hiện có trên mặt đứng
Lan can: Kính trong với tay vịn kim loại mảnh màu tối — Các tấm lan can ban công hiện có, giữ nguyên kích thước và vị trí
Yêu cầu thêm (trong phạm vi đã chọn): Bậc cửa hiện có hoàn thiện đá xám đậm; giữ số bậc và cao độ. Lòng đường hiện có là nhựa đường, không thêm xe hoặc vạch sơn.
Mục bỏ trống: không yêu cầu thay đổi; thông tin thiếu được diễn họa trung tính.
